description: Search archive files the data key can download. Every filter is optional; without a date it lists the newest day in reach. asset is the BASE symbol (BTC, not BTCUSD). interval "5m" EXCLUDES the period-less settlement streams (prices, twap30s, twap60s); pass ["5m","none"] to get both. Ranges are capped at 92 days.

asset.description: Base symbol, e.g. BTC. A list means "any of these".

dataset.description: e.g. prices, twap60s, book, markets, last_trade_price, klines, orderbook. A list means "any of these".

format.description: parquet lists the Parquet copy of each file (same rows, already typed); default gz, the archive files

interval.description: e.g. 5m, 15m, 1m, or "none" for period-less files. A list means "any of these".

limit.description: Rows to return (default 200); count and bytes always cover everything matched.

venue.description: polymarket | predict. A list means "any of these".

name: list_files
